hero.tagline: I build things for the web & mobile.
hero.description: A passionate frontend developer crafting bold digital experiences with React, Next.js, and React Native. I love turning complex problems into simple, beautiful solutions.

about.heading: About Me
about.bio: I'm a frontend developer who loves building products that make a difference. From sleek web apps to performant mobile experiences, I enjoy working across the entire stack. I'm passionate about clean code, modern design patterns, and the developer experience.
about.bioExtended: When I'm not coding, you'll find me swimming laps, cycling through the city, or playing video games. I'm a huge advocate for AI-powered development tools and believe the future of coding is collaborative humans and AI building together.

beyondCode.heading: Beyond The Code
beyondCode.subheading: Life isn't just about semicolons and merge conflicts.
